rule: Boot intro stage, then a random roll picks one of two menu backdrops; unless skipintro or quick-start, a typewritten story screen runs (pause per text box, three Back presses to skip). After the title press, the main menu is created and the one-time binary tutorial prompt is checked: Yes opens the Hall of Trials (tutorial1), No shows a note pointing at the Play Game menu. Class cards show a list and a details card with per-stat colour words; the list is filtered by content-pack validity. New game sets currentlevel to startfloor (0) and the starter kit is hand-coded per class, with the first weapon in hotbar slot 0. The trial hub is a ten-entry list read from data (not in the box), with a completion prompt that counts the remaining trials.
